english: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
text: never dreamed of 在这里表示压根没料到会有这种事，不是从未有过这个愿望。想强调结果出乎意料，可以说 never dreamed of doing；讲普通的未曾预料，didn't expect 也自然。
